messages.author: Ritva Koskilinja
messages.text: Lauri, ge-0/0/2 is flapping, down and up every few minutes. RX power looks fine when it's up. Should I swap the SFP?

messages.author: Lauri Liitin
messages.text: Not yet. If RX power is fine I doubt it's the SFP. Flapping like that is more often a bad fibre bend or a loose patch in the tray. Check the run from ge-0/0/2 to the frame first and reseat the patch at both ends.

messages.author: Ritva Koskilinja
messages.text: Found a tight bend behind the tray. Rerouted it. No flaps for 15 minutes.

messages.author: Lauri Liitin
messages.text: Sounds like that was it. I'd leave the SFP alone unless it starts again.
